sourceHtml:
Meta plans to sell new stock to raise money for its AI infrastructure buildout. According to The Information, the company plans to sell up to $95 billion in shares.

About $22.5 billion will come from selling Class A common stock, according to a Meta announcement. Another $12.5 billion will come from depositary shares, each representing one-twentieth of a new preferred share. Unless they're converted earlier, these preferred shares will automatically convert into common stock in August 2029. The remaining $60 billion will come from ongoing sales on the open market once new Class C shares start trading, likely no earlier than the first quarter of 2027.

Right now, Meta has Class A shares with one vote each and Class B shares with ten votes each. Entities controlled by CEO Mark Zuckerberg hold most of the Class B shares. The Class C shares, which Meta announced last week, carry no voting rights. That lets Meta raise money without diluting Zuckerberg's control. According to the announcement, Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom have expressed non-binding interest in buying up to $5 billion in Meta stock.

translation.html:
Meta 计划发行新股，为其 AI 基础设施建设筹集资金。据 The Information 报道，该公司计划出售至多 950 亿美元的股票。

根据 Meta 的公告，其中约 225 亿美元将通过出售 A 类普通股筹集。另外 125 亿美元将通过出售存托股份筹集，每份存托股份代表一股新优先股的二十分之一。除非提前转换，否则这些优先股将在 2029 年 8 月自动转换为普通股。其余 600 亿美元将通过在新的 C 类股票开始交易后，在公开市场持续出售股票来筹集；新的 C 类股票可能最早也要到 2027 年第一季度才会开始交易。

目前，Meta 的 A 类股票每股拥有一票投票权，B 类股票每股拥有十票投票权。由首席执行官 Mark Zuckerberg 控制的实体持有大部分 B 类股票。Meta 上周宣布的 C 类股票不附带投票权。这使 Meta 能够在不稀释 Zuckerberg 控制权的情况下筹集资金。根据公告，Nvidia、AMD 和 Broadcom 已表达购买至多 50 亿美元 Meta 股票的意向，但该意向不具约束力。
